name: corven-connect-sdk
description: Corven Connect SDK packages. Separate npm workspace from the backend (pnpm) so the backend image and lockfile are unaffected.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @corven/connect && npm run build -w @corven/connect-react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @corven/connect && npm run typecheck -w @corven/connect-react
